topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: These blossoms, so unwanted, clutter my space. They stand there, mocking, with no word to anchor their arrival. Silent gifts, whispers of a presence I wish would fade. Each petal seems to taunt, brighter for their bold intrusion. I don’t need their color, their scent. They are foreign, these offerings, and they bring a storm of unease. The air feels thick around them, heavy with questions that hang, unanswered. I shouldn’t have to wonder, to guess, to sift through shadows for the truth. This is not a time for riddles.
